trap.label: inclined + to
trap.right: We are inclined to think so.
trap.why: Em português “somos inclinados a pensar” pode ser omitido na fala. Em inglês, be inclined to + base.

fix.wrong: We are inclined to thinking so.
fix.right: We are inclined to think so.

rewrite.prompt: Use be inclined to: “We tend to think so.”
rewrite.answer: We are inclined to think so.
